examples: The gate is made of iron.

more.def: A hard, strong metal that is used to make tools, nails and many other things.
examples: The fence is made of iron.
Iron rusts when it gets wet.

easy.def: A tool that you heat to make clothes smooth.
examples: Dad used an iron on the shirt.

more.def: A flat, heated tool used to press wrinkles out of clothes.
examples: Dad used an iron to smooth the wrinkles in his shirt.
The iron is very hot, so do not touch it.
Mom ironed the shirt with a steam iron.
